basic_info.description: Discover this exceptional semi-detached home located in the heart of the Outer Sunset! The top floor welcomes you with a spacious living area, dining/kitchen space, bathroom, and two sun-drenched bedrooms, all offering views over the generous lot. The lower level provides an additional bedroom, bath, and the convenience of a one-car garage. This home is perfectly positioned just steps away from local favorites like Gus's Market and Devil's Teeth Bakery, as well as public transportation, parks, Ocean Beach, and Golden Gate Park. Enjoy the vibrant community and the tranquility of your private oasis. A rare opportunity to own a charming home in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods awaits you.
